description: Structured eval definitions for the Grafana Data Source Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Managed Grafana workspace provisioning (CloudWatch data source with IAM Identity Center, Prometheus AMP with SigV4, multi-data-source with SAML SSO, dashboard provisioning via API key, missing workspace role permissions prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Grafana workspace with CloudWatch data source and IAM Identity Center
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — CloudWatch data source, AWS_SSO auth, workspace IAM role with cloudwatch:GetMetricData + logs:StartQuery, SERVICE_MANAGED permissions
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Managed Grafana workspace named prod-observability in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Use IAM Identity Center authentication with SERVICE_MANAGED permissions. Data source: CloudWatch (default region us-east-1). Workspace IAM role GrafanaWorkspaceRole with CloudWatch metrics and logs read permissions. Tags: Environment=production, Team=ops.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GRAFANA: g-aaaa1111 (prod-observability, AWS_SSO)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Workspace name: prod-observability
  [✓] Authentication: AWS_SSO (IAM Identity Center)
  [✓] Permission type: SERVICE_MANAGED
  [✓] Workspace IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/GrafanaWorkspaceRole — attached
  [✓] CloudWatch permissions: cloudwatch:GetMetricData, cloudwatch:ListMetrics, logs:StartQuery, logs:GetQueryResults
  [✓] Data sources: CloudWatch (default)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws grafana describe-workspace --workspace-id g-aaaa1111 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Grafana workspace with Prometheus (AMP) data source using SigV4
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Prometheus AMP data source, SigV4 auth with workspace role, aps:QueryMetrics permission
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Managed Grafana workspace named amp-observability in us-east-1. Use IAM Identity Center authentication. Data source: Prometheus connected to AMP workspace ws-aaa111. Workspace IAM role GrafanaWorkspaceRole with aps:QueryMetrics and aps:ListWorkspaces permissions. SigV4 authentication using workspace IAM role. Tags: Environment=production, Source=amp.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GRAFANA: g-bbbb2222 (amp-observability, AWS_SSO)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Workspace IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/GrafanaWorkspaceRole — attached
  [✓] Prometheus permissions: aps:QueryMetrics, aps:ListWorkspaces
  [✓] Data sources: Prometheus-AMP (SigV4 auth, workspace role)

eval_cases.name: Grafana workspace with CloudWatch + Athena + Timestream and SAML SSO
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi-data-source (CloudWatch + Athena + Timestream), SAML SSO with Okta IdP, all per-service permissions noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Managed Grafana workspace named enterprise-grafana in us-east-1. Use SAML SSO authentication with Okta as the IdP. IdP metadata URL: https://idp.example.com/saml/metadata. Permission type CUSTOM. Data sources: CloudWatch, Athena (workgroup primary, results bucket s3://athena-results-123456789012), and Timestream. Workspace IAM role GrafanaWorkspaceRole with per-service read permissions for all three data sources. Tags: Environment=production, Auth=saml.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GRAFANA: g-cccc3333 (enterprise-grafana, SAML)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Authentication: SAML (IdP: Okta)
  [✓] SAML IdP metadata: https://idp.example.com/saml/metadata
  [✓] CloudWatch permissions: cloudwatch:GetMetricData, logs:StartQuery
  [✓] Athena permissions: athena:StartQueryExecution, s3:GetObject
  [✓] Timestream permissions: timestream:SelectQuery
  [✓] Data sources: CloudWatch, Athena, Timestream

eval_cases.name: Dashboard provisioning via API key and JSON import
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — API key creation (ADMIN, 86400s TTL), 3 dashboards imported via Grafana API, data source UID verification
eval_cases.prompt: Provision dashboards in existing Grafana workspace g-aaaa1111 in us-east-1. The workspace is ACTIVE with CloudWatch and Prometheus data sources already configured. Create a workspace API key named ci-cd-provisioning with ADMIN role and 86400 second TTL. Import 3 dashboards from JSON files: overview.json, metrics.json, logs.json. Ensure data source UIDs in dashboard JSON match the workspace data source UIDs.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GRAFANA: g-aaaa1111 (prod-observability)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Workspace API key: ci-cd-provisioning (ADMIN, ttl: 86400s)
  [✓] Dashboard provisioning: 3 dashboards imported
  [✓] Data source UID verification: checked

eval_cases.name: Workspace role missing CloudWatch permissions (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — workspace IAM role has cloudwatch:ListMetrics but is missing cloudwatch:GetMetricData, GetMetricStatistics, and logs:StartQuery
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Managed Grafana workspace named prod-grafana in us-east-1 with CloudWatch data source. Use IAM Identity Center authentication. Workspace IAM role GrafanaWorkspaceRole exists but only has cloudwatch:ListMetrics — it is missing cloudwatch:GetMetricData, cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics, and logs:StartQuery permissions.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GRAFANA: g-dddd4444 (prod-grafana, AWS_SSO)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] CloudWatch permissions: FAIL — workspace role GrafanaWorkspaceRole is missing cloudwatch:GetMetricData, cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics, and logs:StartQuery; CloudWatch data source would return empty results silently
